dialogues.en: I mutter, and slide into bed.
dialogues.text: I mutter, and slide into bed.

dialogues.jp:
居間でテーブルを拭いていた頼子さんに一声か
け、俺は部屋へと上っていった。
dialogues.en:
"Behave normally for the rest of the days, huh......? It may
not be so hard......"
dialogues.text:
"Behave normally for the rest of the days, huh......? It may
not be so hard......"

dialogues.en:
...Only if I can deal with the sadness that comes and goes
occasionally.
dialogues.text:
...Only if I can deal with the sadness that comes and goes
occasionally.

dialogues.jp: 何となく呟いて、ベッドに潜り込む。
dialogues.en: And if I put aside the fact that I can't sleep at night...
dialogues.text: And if I put aside the fact that I can't sleep at night...

dialogues.jp: 明後日、頼子さんは消えてしまう。

普段どおりの生活も、思ったより難しくはない
のかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
I say good night to Yoriko-san as she's cleaning the table
in the living room, and go upstairs to my room.
dialogues.text:
I say good night to Yoriko-san as she's cleaning the table
in the living room, and go upstairs to my room.

dialogues.jp:
不意に訪れる悲しみにさえきちんと対処できる
のならば……。
